isApproved.description: Whether the rule is approved and active for matching searches.

scope.description: Search Index and language scope in which the rule applies.

condition.description: Complete condition that activates the Redirect rule.

destination.description: Destination returned in the Search response. Relewise does not perform a browser redirect itself.

data.description: Additional key-value data returned with the redirect.

description: Detailed Redirect rule representation including its complete condition and optional data.
